items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I did get to use it in that festival with the German band I had... Alexander's big mouth was always involved with Ray McKinley too... I remember before we went on that night, he took Bill and I into his little cubicle

ctx.x: I guess the occasion didn't arise. It was not commercial stuff.
I did get to use it in that festival with the German band I had. They didn't like it either.
